leads.name: Bellenden Road Nature Garden
leads.note: LWT mini reserve; no source after 2021; location unclear (Wikipedia: Bellenden Road; planning data: Peckham High Street SE15 5BB)

leads.name: Choumert Square
leads.note: Communal garden behind 46 cottages; opens to the public once a year (NGS), otherwise private

leads.name: Old Kent Road mural (Adam Kossowski, History of the Old Kent Road)
leads.note: Grade II listed 1965 ceramic mural at 600-608 Old Kent Road SE15 1JB (postcode centroid); sources mention civic-centre redevelopment, so unclear whether it is currently on public view

leads.name: Peckham Peace Wall
leads.note: 2011 post-it riot wall preserved as a permanent mural on the western wall of Peckham Square (Garudio Studiage); newest source found is 2012, so current display unconfirmed; pin is Peckham Library, next to the square

leads.name: Goose Green Blake mural (A Vision of Angels)
leads.note: Verified by 2 sources, but the pin reused Goose Green playground's coordinates: find the mural's own location

leads.name: Daniels Road community garden (former car park)
leads.note: Only a Southwark Cleaner Greener Safer funding line to convert Daniels Road car park into a community garden; not known whether it was built or is public. Pin is street centre of Daniel's Road, SE15.

leads.name: Elmington Community Gardens (Brisbane Street wildlife triangle)
leads.note: Estate wildlife/community garden run by a charity (no. 1206069); public access and exact spot unclear. Pin is street centre of Brisbane Street, SE5.

leads.name: Camberwell Identity mural, Wren Road (Butterfly Walk)
leads.note: Only one source mentions a mural on Wren Road at Butterfly Walk; subject and exact wall unknown. Pin is street centre of Wren Road, SE5.

leads.name: Camberwell Beauty Doulton tile mural, Wells Way
leads.note: Doulton tile panel from the Samuel Jones factory, resited 1983 on the south gable of the former library on Wells Way by Burgess Park; mentioned in Burgess Park review. Pin is Wells Way street centre; outside this run's cells, could be a separate landmark with a second source.

leads.name: Old Kent Road bridge mural (Not any old Road – A Home from Home)
leads.note: Community mural on both sides of the Old Kent Road railway bridge, finished autumn 2024 and winner of a 2025 Planning Award. Well sourced (oldkentroad.org.uk, Southwark News, illustrationx) but the exact bridge position is unconfirmed: sources say only 'where Old Kent Road becomes New Cross Road, on the Southwark/Lewisham boundary'. The pin is postcode SE15 1NJ (Asylum Road/Ilderton Road junction), a placeholder.

leads.name: Pat Hickson Garden
leads.note: Council-landscaped community garden on Ilderton Road SE16, opened Oct 2021, with a path linking Surrey Canal Road to Stockholm Road. Both sources are Southwark Council (news plus parks list). Exact position along Ilderton Road is unknown (pin is the Ilderton Road SE15 street centre), and nothing describes features for kids.

leads.name: Camberwell Triangle Garden (Goschen allotments)
leads.note: Garden with a lawn, wildlife planting and a new pond (Southwark News, Mar 2024; GoodGym 2023). On an allotment site near the Goschen Estate (pin is the Bethwin Road SE5 street centre). Exact site and public access are unconfirmed.

leads.name: Elmington Community Gardens wildlife triangle (Brisbane Street)
leads.note: Rewild London-funded corridor of six small sites on the Elmington Estate linking Burgess Park to Benhill Road Nature Garden; a GoodGym listing names a 'Wildlife Triangle on Brisbane Street'. Unclear which sites are public or worth a visit. Pin is the Brisbane Street SE5 street centre.

leads.name: Camberwell Secret Garden (D'Eynsford Estate)
leads.note: Estate community garden run by the tenant management group (GoodGym, plus a property listing). Public access and location within the estate are unknown. Pin is the D'Eynsford Road SE5 street centre.

leads.name: New Cross Gate Cutting (Brockley Nature Reserve)
leads.note: London Wildlife Trust reserve, entrance Vesta Road SE4 2NR (postcode pin). Locked except monthly open days (last Saturday, 1-4pm per older pages) and volunteer days; no 2026 calendar found.

leads.name: Addington Square Garden
leads.note: Public Georgian garden square by Burgess Park (open 7.30am-sunset per LGT); Southwark heritage mentions a 1935 jubilee playground but no current source confirms play equipment, so kid value unclear. Postcode SE5 7LB pin.

leads.name: New Cross Gate Cutting
leads.note: London Wildlife Trust reserve (Metropolitan SINC) with its entrance on Vesta Road, SE4, but restricted access: open only on occasional open days and volunteer workdays. Pin is Vesta Road street centre.

leads.name: Nairne Grove nature reserve
leads.note: Named in Southwark planning data (TPO woodland zone, point given) and a 2015 cabinet report as a proposed Borough SINC 'Nairne Grove Nature Garden'. No visitor information; public access unknown.

leads.name: Congreve Community Garden
leads.note: Only Southwark Cleaner Greener Safer funding applications (2012/13 and a 2023/24 redesign bid); estate garden, public access and exact spot unknown. Pin is Congreve Street, SE17 street centre.

leads.name: Stik mural, Hansler Road
leads.note: Stik piece on the side of Property Inn, Hansler Road, East Dulwich (Dulwich Outdoor Gallery); sources are 2012-2017 and a Stik mural was stolen in East Dulwich in 2013, so it may be gone. Pin is Hansler Road street centre.

leads.name: Nunhead Green
leads.note: Listed as a pocket park in the Mayor's Pocket Parks programme (SE15 3QQ, postcode pin); only one source and no detail on what is there for children.

leads.name: Rouel Road estate community orchard (Rouel Blue Garden Club)
leads.note: One news source: allotments and a 24-tree orchard on a former football pitch at St James's Road / Alexis Street, said to be 'open to all'. Need a second source and confirmation of public access; located at the Alexis Street street centre

leads.name: Southwark Park Wildlife Garden
leads.note: Wildlife garden (mini woodland) on the eastern side of Southwark Park, reportedly open at weekends. Exact position in the park unknown (Hawkstone Road street centre used); the park's playgrounds are already on the map, so check whether a separate entry is wanted

leads.name: 'Truth instructing children' sculpture, Flint Street
leads.note: Only a photographer's caption names it on Flint Street, SE17. No sculptor, date or exact spot found; may be on a school building. Flint Street street centre used

leads.name: Rothsay Street mural (Barnie and Matlakas)
leads.note: Community mural by Emma Barnie and Riccardo Matlakas off Tower Bridge Road, Sept 2023; one source only, exact wall unknown. Pin is Rothsay Street, SE1 street centre.

leads.name: Dream Garden pocket park (Tanner Street)
leads.note: Pocket park between Tanner Street and Coxson Way (SE1 2XB) used by Avant-Gardening; only GLA event listings from c.2019, no facilities or current access info. Pin is the SE1 2XB postcode.

leads.name: Kingfisher mural, Lordship Lane
leads.note: Kingfisher mural on a building on Lordship Lane, East Dulwich; one undated student article, no building number or artist. Pin is Lordship Lane, SE22 street centre.

leads.name: The Garden SE8 (Lower Road community garden)
leads.note: Garden at Lower Road Community Association crowdfunding (Spacehive) to turn a derelict strip on Lower Road just north of Croft Street into a community garden with a pond and fruit trees. Not known whether it is built or open to the public. Pin is Croft Street, SE8 street centre.

leads.name: Paper Garden (Global Generation), Canada Water
leads.note: Charity-run community garden and handcrafted classroom at Teredo Street SE16 7LD (postcode not in gazetteer; pin is Teredo Street centre). Visits seem to be booked or event-based (Southwark guided visits from Canada Water Library, family celebration days), so drop-in public access is unclear.

leads.name: Greenwood Theatre pocket park (Zandra Rhodes / Joe Swift)
leads.note: Linear colourful planted pocket park on Greenwood Theatre walls, corner of Weston Street and Snowsfields SE1; sources from 2014-15 only, current state unknown and little for children.

leads.name: Florence Green (Florence Road verge garden)
leads.note: Residents' road-island garden on Florence Road SE14 with bug hotel, public art and a nature trail (groups formed 2023); only one source, small verge.

leads.name: Breakspears Mews Community Garden
leads.note: Volunteer-run Brockley Society food/flower garden off Ashby Road SE4 (street-centre pin for Breakspears Mews). Only Brockley Society pages; last stated public opening was Sundays 11am-1pm (Nov 2021). Need a second, recent source and current opening.

leads.name: Three Perpetual Chords (Conrad Shawcross), Dulwich Park
leads.note: Three cast-iron sculptures (2015) along a path at the northern end of Dulwich Park, replacing the stolen Hepworth. Well sourced (Contemporary Art Society, Londonist 2015, Dulwich Park Friends) but sources are from 2015 and the exact spot is not given; pin is an approximate point at the north of the park. Confirm the location and that they are still in place.

leads.name: Devonshire Road Nature Reserve
leads.note: Lewisham nature reserve at 170 Devonshire Road SE23 3SZ, locked except open days (council: last Sunday of the month 2-5pm). Pinned to postcode SE23 3SZ (gazetteer). Limited opening, so recorded as a lead.

leads.name: The Boat mural, St George's Residence, Railton Road
leads.note: Mural on St George's Residence, Railton Road, seen from Effra Parade; said to be a 1988 London Wall Mural Group work, recently rediscovered. Only Wikipedia's Brixton murals list (citation needed). Pin is the Effra Parade street centre.

leads.name: The Hithe community garden (Albion Street)
leads.note: Meanwhile community garden/hub at 71-75 Albion Street SE16 7JA (pin = gazetteer SE16 7JA). Family events and half-term activities, but no regular public opening times found and the site is earmarked for redevelopment.

leads.name: Earth Tenders community garden, Dulwich Park
leads.note: Community food garden behind Rosebery Lodge in Dulwich Park (SE21 7EX, gazetteer centre; approximate). Family events held, but unclear whether open to drop-in visitors outside sessions.

leads.name: Elba Place Nature Garden
leads.note: Small nature area with pond, wildflower bank and raised beds in the centre of Victory Community Park (Walworth). GiGL says free access but Southwark lists the nature area as open by appointment. Pin = gazetteer centre of Elba Place, SE17.

leads.name: Stockwell Park Estate fish pond (duck pond and island)
leads.note: Local Wildlife Site pond with island on the Stockwell Park Estate, viewable only from adjacent paths (GiGL via search summary; Brixton Buzz 2020). Exact location on the estate not confirmed; pin = gazetteer centre of Stockwell Park Road, SW9.

leads.name: Kennington Play Project mural (Peter Sellers, by DMT), Bolton Crescent
leads.note: Lambeth borough photos archive (2005, 2008) show a commissioned mural by DMT depicting Peter Sellers on the Kennington Play Project building, Bolton Crescent. No recent source; may have been painted over. Pin = SE5 0SE (Bolton Crescent adventure playground postcode), same site not confirmed.

leads.name: Spurgeon Estate Secret Garden, Stockwell
leads.note: Residents' kitchen and woodland wildlife garden reopened 2019 in the centre of the Spurgeon Estate (Love Lambeth, Incredible Edible, London Gardens Trust Open Gardens 2025/2026). Seems open to estate residents and on open-garden days only; drop-in public access unconfirmed. Pin = nearest postcode SW8 1UL given by the source.

leads.name: Ferranti Park
leads.note: Small (0.29 ha) Green Flag park on Creekside next to Sue Godfrey Nature Park (Lewisham, Wikipedia, GiGL). Sources don't confirm play equipment or anything for children. Pin = Berthon Street (an access point) street centre.

leads.name: Confluence Place park, Lewisham Gateway
leads.note: New park where the Ravensbourne and Quaggy meet, with children's play space per Lewisham Council; 2024 blog says public space beginning to open. Completion and current access unconfirmed. Pin = Station Road SE13 street centre (approximate).

leads.name: Forest Hill station mural (Artmongers)
leads.note: Forest Hill Society mural by Patricio Forrester/Artmongers on a wall by the station and South Circular; painting started 28 Sep 2024. Only Forest Hill Society pages; completion not confirmed. Pin = postcode SE23 3HD (chosen by us, near the station).

leads.name: Sir John McDougall Gardens
leads.note: Verified by 2 sources (riverside toddler and junior play), but the pin was the Westferry Road street centre, which may be hundreds of metres off: find a postcode or stated coordinates

leads.name: Wall of Heroes mural, West Dulwich station
leads.note: Marlon Brown's 2011 mural (Attenborough, Rosalind Franklin, plus the 'Wild Wall' with Darwin and Wallace) on a shop by the station entrance. Only a 2018 Londonist article; not confirmed it still exists. Pin is station postcode SE21 8HN.

leads.name: Newcomen Street community garden
leads.note: New volunteer-built community garden near Guy's Hospital (March 2026, Team London Bridge). One source only; public access and exact site not confirmed. Pin is the Newcomen Street street centre (offline gazetteer).

leads.name: Sydenham Garden (Wynell Road community garden and nature reserve)
leads.note: Postcode SE23 2LW from Time Out. Wellbeing charity garden; a forum post says it opens to the public only on certain days (Wednesdays and some Saturdays). Current public opening not confirmed.

leads.name: Rush Common Woodland Walk playground, Brixton Hill
leads.note: Lambeth describes a tree-covered Woodland Walk with a children's playground along Brixton Hill (opposite Lambeth College). Rush Common is almost a mile long; pin is Lambeth's listed postcode SW2 3RN, not the playground itself. Brixton Orchard (already on the map) is part of Rush Common.

leads.name: Cable Street Community Gardens
leads.note: Resident-run garden with ponds and wildlife areas; entrance Hardinge Street, postcode E1 0EL. Sources show it opening on Open Gardens weekends (and Sunday hours listed there); not clear it is open to the public at other times.

leads.name: Welland Street playspace (Meridian Estate)
leads.note: Royal Greenwich is refurbishing the play space between Welland Street and Thames Street (design workshop March 2026). Pin is the Welland Street street centre. Check whether the new playground has opened.

leads.name: South London Botanical Institute garden
leads.note: Botanical garden and herbarium at 323 Norwood Road SE24 9AQ (postcode pin). Free on open days, but drop-in opening seems limited (Thursdays 11am-4pm per one source, plus Sunday events, some ticketed). Children's workshops exist. Access pattern unclear for families.

leads.name: William Mitchell murals, Foxborough Gardens
leads.note: 1957-63 decorative entrance murals by William Mitchell on two LCC blocks at Foxborough Gardens SE4 1HT (postcode pin); C20 Society and Lewisham libraries talk (2024) say they fell into disrepair and residents campaign to restore them. Unclear if visible from public paths or restored.

leads.name: Wildcat Wilderness (Rushey Green Time Bank)
leads.note: Community green space and food-growing garden by the river, gate at 53 River View Park Road SE6 4PL (postcode pin). Run by Rushey Green Time Bank; listings mention Wed/Fri/Sat sessions but no public opening hours confirmed.

leads.name: Conor Harrington mural, Trafalgar Road
leads.note: Large 2020 London Mural Festival wall at 71 Trafalgar Road SE10 9TS (postcode pin), overlooking a car park earmarked for development; sources from 2020 only, so it may be gone.

leads.name: All Hallows Churchyard (Copperfield Street Community Garden)
leads.note: Resident-run community garden around a bombed church, supported by BOST; LGT says open, unrestricted. Little documented for children, and an undated SE1 report says the cathedral once padlocked the gates. Pin is Copperfield Street, SE1 street centre.

leads.name: Crossbones Graveyard and Garden of Remembrance
leads.note: Volunteer-run memorial garden on Redcross Way SE1 1TA (postcode pin; entrance on Union Street). Open only Wed-Fri plus first Saturday 12-2pm per BOST (other sources differ). Limited opening and sombre theme.

leads.name: Brockwell Park Community Greenhouses
leads.note: 2 sources; pin is a postcode at the park edge a few hundred metres from the greenhouses: find a precise location

leads.name: Stockwell Hall of Fame (Aytoun Road graffiti enclosure)
leads.note: Former playground enclosure on the Stockwell Park Estate used as a tolerated graffiti wall since 1993; only source is the Lambeth borough photo archive (photos 2008-2018). Current status unconfirmed. Pin is the Aytoun Road street centre.

leads.name: Huggins Corner (Roupell Road garden and mural)
leads.note: Small public wildflower garden (about 400 m2) with a 55 m mural on its back wall and bollards painted by Streatham Wells pupils. Only one source (Lambeth Council). Pin is a Roupell Road street centre; Roupell Road is several hundred metres long, so find the exact corner.

leads.name: Pearl and Mizanur's Memorial Garden, Shadwell
leads.note: Resident-run garden between Cornwall Street and Cable Street on the Tarling West Estate, nearest postcode E1 2QW. Only source is the London Open Gardens listing; unclear whether it is open outside open-garden weekends.

leads.name: Leake Street Pocket Park / Baylis Road Pocket Park
leads.note: Two small Waterloo pocket parks (Baylis Road, SE1 7AY, built 2020; Leake Street, opened 2015). Planting only in sources; unclear there is anything for children.
